simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֹפֶן (H655) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אֹפֶן (ʼôphen) means a turn , i.e. a season First listed occurrence: Prov 25 11.

definitions.full: H655. ophen [ אֹ֫פֶן ] noun [masculine] circumstance, condition (perhaps literally turning ) only dual (or plural) suffix עַלאָֿפְנָיו = in (right) circumstances Prov 25:11 (compare Str on the passage , also Orelli Syn. d. Zeit u. Ewigkeit 38 f. ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to revolve;
